CALC-001.business_meaning: Calculates the gross pre-discount line monetary amount for a single sold product line based on quantity and unit selling price.
CALC-001.trigger: Product scanned/added to cart or quantity modified in POS
CALC-001.null_handling: Default quantity to 1, unit_price to 0.00 if null
CALC-001.negative_value_handling: Negative quantity prohibited; throws validation error

CALC-002.business_meaning: Sum of all line item subtotals for an entire sale transaction prior to order-level discount and tax.

CALC-003.business_meaning: Computes the absolute monetary discount deducted from the sale subtotal based on fixed amount or percentage.
CALC-003.trigger: Operator inputs discount value or percentage in POS modal

CALC-004.business_meaning: Calculates government tax liability added to the discounted taxable base of the sale.

CALC-005.business_meaning: Final net payable monetary amount for the sale invoice after discount deduction and tax addition.

CALC-006.business_meaning: Unpaid residual balance on a sale transaction that is posted to customer accounts receivable (Khata).

CALC-007.business_meaning: Physical cash currency returned to customer when tendered cash exceeds sale grand total.
CALC-007.trigger: Operator inputs tendered cash in payment modal

CALC-008.calculation_name: Sale Line Item Cost of Goods Sold (COGS)
CALC-008.business_meaning: Cost basis of goods sold on a transaction line based on historical product unit cost at time of sale.

CALC-009.business_meaning: Gross monetary profit generated by a sale transaction after deducting total COGS from net sales revenue.
CALC-009.boundary_conditions: Can be negative if sold below cost

CALC-010.business_meaning: Markup percentage of gross profit relative to selling price.

CALC-011.business_meaning: Gross procurement amount for a single purchase bill item before purchase discount and tax.

CALC-012.business_meaning: Sum of all purchase line item subtotals for an entire inbound shipment bill.

CALC-013.business_meaning: Transportation and delivery charges billed on the purchase invoice.
CALC-013.trigger: Operator enters freight cost in purchase creation form

CALC-014.business_meaning: Computes vendor discount deductions and applicable purchase taxes on procurement bill.

CALC-015.business_meaning: Total gross obligation owed to supplier for the purchase bill including freight and taxes after discounts.

CALC-016.business_meaning: Unpaid residual supplier liability on a purchase bill added to accounts payable.

CALC-017.calculation_name: Product Moving Average Unit Cost Price
CALC-017.business_meaning: Perpetual weighted-average inventory acquisition cost updated upon receiving new inventory batches.
CALC-017.ledger_usage: Sets cost basis for subsequent inventory_movements and COGS

CALC-018.business_meaning: Monetary value of inventory stock on hand at cost price for a specific branch or whole business.
CALC-018.negative_value_handling: Negative stock treated as 0 in valuation or negative value

CALC-019.business_meaning: Monetary refund credit for a single returned item line based on returned quantity and original sale unit price.

CALC-020.business_meaning: Sum of all return line refund amounts refunded to customer via cash or Khata store credit.
CALC-020.ledger_usage: Cash drawer outflow or Khata credit adjustment

CALC-021.business_meaning: Cumulative net monetary amount owed by a customer across all credit sales, payments, and returns.
CALC-021.trigger: Credit sale, customer payment voucher, return credit, manual adjustment
CALC-021.negative_value_handling: Negative balance indicates customer in advance credit
CALC-021.ledger_usage: Materialized cache verified against khata_transactions ledger

CALC-022.business_meaning: Remaining borrowing capacity for a customer before reaching maximum credit threshold.
CALC-022.null_handling: credit_limit 0 or null treated as unlimited

CALC-023.business_meaning: Cumulative net monetary liability owed to a vendor across all credit purchases, payments, and cancellations.
CALC-023.trigger: Credit purchase, supplier payment voucher, purchase cancel
CALC-023.negative_value_handling: Negative balance indicates advance payment made to supplier
CALC-023.ledger_usage: Materialized cache updated upon purchase and payment mutations

CALC-024.calculation_name: Supplier Payment Voucher Allocation to Unpaid Purchases
CALC-024.business_meaning: Applies a supplier payment voucher to open purchase bills, reducing individual purchase due amounts.
CALC-024.ledger_usage: Updates purchase statuses to PAID or PARTIAL

CALC-025.business_meaning: Real-time monetary ledger balance of a bank or electronic financial account derived from cumulative debits and credits.
CALC-025.trigger: Sale deposit, customer payment, purchase disbursement, supplier payment, expense, transfer, capital movement
CALC-025.ledger_usage: Materialized balance verified against account_movements ledger

CALC-026.business_meaning: Running cash balance for a store branch computed from cumulative cash ledger inflows and outflows.
CALC-026.trigger: Cash sale, cash return refund, cash expense, manual cash adjustment
CALC-026.negative_value_handling: Prohibited (drawer cannot physically hold negative cash)

CALC-027.business_meaning: Variance between physical cash counted by cashier and the expected running cash balance.
CALC-027.negative_value_handling: Negative indicates shortage; positive indicates surplus

CALC-028.business_meaning: Disbursed monetary amount for store operations categorized under specific expense category.
CALC-028.ledger_usage: Deducts from financial account or cash drawer

CALC-029.business_meaning: Total gross sales minus discounts, taxes, and customer returns within a specified reporting time window.
CALC-029.trigger: Dashboard page load / date filter selection
CALC-029.negative_value_handling: Can be negative if returns exceed sales in narrow window

CALC-030.calculation_name: Dashboard Period Net Operating Profit Metric
CALC-030.business_meaning: Bottom-line operational profit computed as Gross Profit minus Operating Expenses within the reporting timeframe.

CALC-031.calculation_name: Dashboard Total Accounts Payable & Receivable Aggregates
CALC-031.business_meaning: Company-wide cumulative outstanding liabilities owed to suppliers and outstanding assets owed by customers.

CALC-032.calculation_name: Period Net Cash & Liquid Capital Movement
CALC-032.business_meaning: Net change in liquid capital across physical cash drawers and bank accounts over a specified period.
